title: Openings, shopfronts and signs across Glassford Street and along Garth Street, read from Trades Hall's public 8K panoramas

licence.panoramas: Trades Hall Glasgow's public 8K panoramas (twin.venviewer.com/trades-hall, our own capture, 11 July 2026); every station used is checked against the manifest's SHA-256
licence.model: placed on the city model merchant-city-v2 (Contains LiDAR data: Crown copyright Scottish Government and Fugro (2020), OGL v3.0)
licence.note: No third-party data. What is lit at night is art direction: the panoramas show the bars' and shops' lights at blue hour and the offices dark; which windows light is the planner's choice, by a hash of each opening's id.

method: Each wall's photograph is rectified onto a plane through the city model's wall (the plane below) from the named stations' equirectangular panoramas (project.py's camera model; planner = (8.795 - X, Z - 0.045, Y + 4.963) of the E57 frame), at the resolution named, with a metre grid; each opening's rectangle is read from it by eye: u along the wall, h above the pavement (y -3.79). Where two stations see a feature, they agree within 0.7 m. Along Garth Street the stations see the walls at grazing angles, so positions there are good to about a metre.
